info.desc: Stankonia is the fourth studio album by American hip hop duo OutKast, released October 31, 2000 on La Face Records. The album debuted at number 2 on the U.S. Billboard 200 chart, selling over 530,000 copies the first week. Stankonia received universal acclaim from most music critics, based on an aggregate score of 95/100 from Metacritic. It received rave reviews from publications such as USA Today and the Los Angeles Times. It was also voted as the best album of the year in The Village Voice Pazz & Jop critics' poll. podcast.body: This album, which arrived in November 2000, featured an album cover photo depicting Big Boi and Andre 3000 in front of an all-black American flag, with Dre flexing his hands at the camera. It debuted to over half a million sales in its first week, landing at number two on the charts; it would have been number one if not for Jay-Z's *The Dynasty* released the same week. *Stankonia* was Outcast's biggest and most sonically expansive album to date, blending elements of funk, psychedelia, gospel, rock, and club music with hip hop. By February 2001, it had already achieved triple platinum status and eventually sold 4 million copies. "The album was Outcast's biggest and most sonically expansive to date, incorporating elements of funk, psychedelia, gospel, rock, and club music, all fused with hip hop."
